title: Austin Leaders at Chamber Luncheon
summary:
*   Austin leaders will attend the Austin Chamber’s 138th Annual Meeting and Luncheon at the Hilton Austin.
*   Scheduled for February 3rd at 11:00 AM, this is primarily a networking and discussion event.
*   It's important to note that no formal city actions, votes, or policy decisions will be made by officials present.
